source: Maintained SEED P01: four participants, obols, sigils, curse, rites, raven protection, theft, short board and bounded match. No historical P01 executable/package was recovered; current implementations are new.
authorship: New Codex implementation and design under Martin Melcop Neto's portfolio direction. No recovered code or independent human playtest.
accepted_differences: New eight-venue deterministic C# economy, 20 rounds, any-seat solo and shared-device play for two to four local participants, with optional Planning/Classic rivals. Historical 48 tiles/15 turns/minigames/LAN remain candidate plans, not recovered functionality.
technology: C#/.NET 10 Core/CLI economy 0.1.0 and Godot .NET 4.6.3 native 0.5.0. SDK 10.0.401 compiles the existing typed rules. Journal Snapshot/Replay helpers reuse its unchanged schema-1 validation. Native controls use a boardSchema-1 envelope; exported economy journals omit those controls. The Linux distribution includes the verified official release engine and self-contained .NET 10.0.12; the optional project pack retains its external-engine/runtime contract.
media: No external art/audio or franchise characters. Official Godot/.NET binaries are redistributed with their licenses and third-party notices; no SDK or editor assemblies are included.
quality_boundary: Actual standalone native execution, package integrity, scripted system input and implementing-agent review. No independent human play, physical hardware/accessibility, other OS, commercial demand or historical restoration is claimed.
native: Any-seat solo and all nonempty local-seat sets; explicit turn handoff, actor-correct map/objective/previews/results, bounded rival forecasts up to the next human choice, local-seat save/replay and original-format export. No economic rules, historical art, network game or unknown human plans are added.

distribution.rules_and_saves: Unchanged economy 0.1.0, journal schema 1 and boardSchema 1; historical ZIPs preserved.
